'''2018 MPC Charlie Arlandson DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Charlie Arlandson]] at [[2018 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Charlie Arlandson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
